Title: Japan's Mosquito Spray Rule: Never Spray It On Your Skin

Description:
This KINCHO mosquito spray from Don Quijote in Osaka comes with a warning most bug sprays don't: never spray it directly on your body. Instead you press it once toward the ceiling and walls, the chemical clings there, and any mosquito that lands on that spot dies on contact — some users say it works even with the windows open. One press lasts about 12 hours, and a single can holds enough to carry you into next summer.
